entries.text: Increase your Garden Level to unlock new visitors, crops and more!
entries.raw: §8Increase your Garden Level to unlock new visitors, crops and more!
entries.zh: 提升花园等级，解锁新访客、新作物等更多内容!

entries.text: Improve visibility of the fresh produce your Garden has to offer.
entries.raw: §7Improve visibility of the fresh produce your Garden has to offer.
entries.zh: 加大宣传力度，让更多人知道花园里的新鲜农产品。

entries.text: Lobby the government of SkyBlock to allow more Visitors on your Garden at once.
entries.raw: §7Lobby the government of SkyBlock to allow more Visitors on your Garden at once.
entries.zh: 向 SkyBlock 政府争取提高花园同时接待的访客数量。
